display_title: Read typical's heavy steps from its saved end, not a replay

head_commit.message:
Read typical's heavy steps from its saved end, in jobs after typical's last link

A readings job replayed typical's whole play to reach its chapter (about 190 to 330 s of CPU on days 22 and 23), once per
part, so splitting a chapter into more parts bought little. It now loads the saved end (the last chapter's end is saved by no
route, so that one plays on from the end before), and runs in chapter-saves-readings after chapter-saves-typical-c, as the
rebased parts do.

display_title: Hold two of Lucy's jobs for the late stretches with nothing to queue

head_commit.message:
Hold Lucy's last two jobs for the stretches with no build to queue

j_ridge now waits for 477 h on the season's clock (after typical's B17, in the
B17 to T13 stretch) and j_tally for 522 h (between I2 and B19), instead of
following the countdown straight on from j_snares. On the countdown alone all
six of day sixteen's jobs landed in days 16-17, while days 19-22 had visits
with no build, offer or ask on screen.

Part of #454.

head_commit.message:
Offer the running cards a rule is about in the simple view's When row

More options: the cards its effect reaches (a kept lane, or a side a fight card
is on), then those that make what it takes, then those that take what it makes.
Changing the action drops a running subject the new action no longer offers.
